messages.subject: fix parameters (index)
parts:
hi!

a trivial question (sorry!) 

Let’s say I only want to fix p = 1 for 1987 (the 7th and last year in the dipperCH dataset)
how do I specify that?
this:

openCR.fit(dipperCH, type = 'CJS', model = c(phi~t, p~t), fixed=list(p=1)

makes it so all the p’s are fixed to 1, and normal ways to index doesn’t seem to help (e.g. p[1], etc)

Lee

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: fix parameters (index)
parts:
For this you can use the (well hidden) 'details' argment fixedbeta:

openCR.fit(dipperCH, type = 'CJS', model = c(phi~t, p~t), details = list(fixedbeta=c(rep(NA,5),1e3,rep(NA,6))))

I get:

    1985   0.9008     0.05384 0.7360 0.9673
    1986   0.9324     0.04581 0.7685 0.9829

    1983   0.4782     0.05971 0.3644 0.5943

The fixedbeta vector has NA for each beta parameter except the one(s) you want to fix. It's mentioned lower down the help page for ipsecr.fit.

Murray
